title: salvia tetragona
intro: Salvia tetragona, commonly known as Aztec sage or Mexican sage, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used for centuries to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Salvia tetragona include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Salvia tetragona include salvinic acid, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds that contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
